segments.dry: One reviewer with extremely dry, sensitive skin reports the cleanser is effective but a bit drying, suggesting it may suit oily skin better.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no burning or irritation, though a few note it can feel slightly drying on days their skin is already sensitive.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports it does not dry out her face, alongside a mild dislike of the scent.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it cleans thoroughly while keeping their skin comfortably balanced.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report it cleans without stripping or tightness, but a few, including one with extremely dry, sensitive skin, describe it as slightly drying.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers managing acne-prone skin report clearer skin and fewer breakouts with regular use, though one notes the cleanser can be drying or irritating if used more than once a day.

extraits.titre: Good, but probably better for oily skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and this face wash is so effective but it is a bit drying. The smell and consistency is wonderful, so I'll be excited to give it another try in summer. If you have oily skin, this is probably a game changer.

I've really enjoyed using this cleanser! It has a light, refreshing foam that leaves my skin feeling clean without stripping it. The scent is subtle and fresh, and it does a great job removing everyday buildup. I've noticed my skin looks a bit brighter and smoother since adding it to my routine. The only reason it's not a full 5 stars is that it can feel slightly drying on days when my skin is already sensitive. Overall, a great everyday cleanser for a fresh, detoxed feel.

[I received the product in exchange for my honest review] Lathers up quickly with just a small amount. When it's washed off, face feels cleansed and fresh. Didn't cause any irritation or redness. Great in sensitive skin. Did not leave any tightness or dryness.

extraits.titre: Clears acne prone skin almost immediately
extraits.texte: Deep cleans your skin with tiny micro bubbles and rich lather. This soap is effective and may be my new go to for my acne prone skin Pros: Unscented Cleans really deep Helped clear my breakout prone skin. I have no had a single pimple since I started using this product 2 weeks ago. Cons: Can be drying and irritated skin. I found that limiting my use to 1x per day was really the solution here. I think this cleans so well and opens up pores and makes absorption of other products more effective - which is great! But my skin required some adjusting.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Thank you Goop Beauty for letting me try the Daily Detox Foaming Cleanser for free! This is my new favorite facial cleanser!!! This soap is top-notch! It lathers beautifully and feels so lightweight. The smell is so fresh and I love the consistency! I've been using this soap for about a week and a half now and you can definitely tell the difference in using this soap compared to other brands. There is absolutely no product buildup or soap scummy feeling and my skin is noticeably smoother and softer. I love it! I think this has also cleared up some of my acne and acne scars. I don't think this soap specifically targets those things, but I think the excellent cleaning power has kept a lot of debris from filling up my pores. It's like magic! Overall, I really really enjoy using this soap and I am really looking forward to keeping it as a part of my skin care routine! Tha ks again!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Definitely liked this face wash it's a gel that turns into a foam consistency. Feels very refreshing and clean afterwards. I do have oily skin as well. It does have a little scent that I don't care for. Also does take all makeup off. Which is a big plus. Definitely recommend this product to anyone looking for a new face wash to add to their skin routine. I did receive this product for free from influencer in exchange for my honest review.

extraits.titre: Finally a cleanser that's simpatico with my skin
extraits.texte: Love this cleanser! I have roseacea and am always hesitant about trying new cleansers as they tend to be too harsh. This cleanser is gentle but removes dirt, grime and makeup without leaving my skin dry. The pump dispenses the perfect amount of product, and combined with a little water on my face, creates a silky soapy texture for massaging into the skin. It rinses off easily and smells lovely. I will continue to use this cleanser.
